findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - another change lands the same repair on the default branch before this fix closes.
The three-dot diff compares HEAD with the merge base, so it still lists the already-landed product file. close.py:743–745 deliberately skips merging a clean default-branch update, allowing this check to pass. Land can subsequently merge the default branch during its retest and publish a result containing only records without repeating this guard (merge.py:122–153). The amended regression test manually merges origin/main before closing, which hides this path. Check the fix's remaining contribution against the current default branch and cover the case without that manual merge.
findings.title: Refuse records-only results when main already contains the code

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a worker updates Forge's roadmap or story records, then stops before implementing the repair.
This predicate counts plans/roadmap.json, plans/<KEY>.md and plans/<KEY>.read.md as completed work, although the review contract identifies those as Forge's own records. A branch containing only those files and its .factory records therefore passes this guard; close's records-only shortcut then supplies a clean review (close.py:305–307 and its records_only review branch), allowing land to merge it. Exclude the known Forge record paths while preserving ordinary documentation and requested plan documents such as plans/result.md. The new test exercises only .factory and spotted records, so it misses this bypass.
findings.title: Exclude roadmap and story records from the work check
